value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre runs Parent and Tot (18 months–3.11 yrs) Sept 12–Dec 18, price not listed on their site. They also have a Pre-School Drop-In (under 4) Tuesdays & Thursdays 9:30am–12pm from Oct 9, $15, their site says. I couldn't get into their page today to check registration, so I'll keep watching and text you once I can confirm it.
